logger.doc:name: Start Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Started IDP document processing for data extraction", "timeStamp": vars.startTime }]

logger.doc:name: Logging Input Payload
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload]

logger.doc:name: Logging Records Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Failed", "claimNumber": vars.claimNumber, "message": "Records processing failed due to data issues" }]

logger.doc:name: Logging Records Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Failed", "claimNumber": vars.claimNumber, "message": "Records processing failed due to connectivity issues" }]

logger.doc:name: Logging All Files Success Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Success", "claimNumber": vars.claimNumber, "message": "All the documents were processed successfully" }]

logger.doc:name: End Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Completed IDP document processing for data extraction", "timeStamp": now(), "processingtime(minutes)": (now() - vars.startTime).minutes }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (payload.label) match { case str if str == p('salesforce.document.fsrLabel') -> "exceptionConfidenceScore" case str if str == p('salesforce.document.dnLabel') -> "exceptionConfidenceScore" case str if str == p('salesforce.document.firLabel') -> "exceptionConfidenceScore" else -> "allConfidenceScore" }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/json --- payload wait 10000

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- (flatten(payload.tables pluck ((value, key, index) -> value))) map ((item, index) -> item pluck ((value, key, index) -> { (key) : value.value, ((key ++ "ConfidenceScore") : value.confidenceScore) if(!isEmpty(value.value)) }) reduce ((item, accumulator) -> accumulator ++ item))

logger.doc:name: Payload Debug Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload]

set-variable.value: #["No file data found for the label : " ++ vars.document.label]
set-variable.doc:name: Content Version Message Variable

logger.doc:name: Empty File Label Names

set-variable.value: #[vars.document.label ++ " is not included in the list of files to be processed by IDP"]
set-variable.doc:name: Content Version Message Variable

logger.doc:name: Non IDP Processing File Label Names

ee:dynamic-evaluate.doc:name: Mapping Request Dynamic Based On Label

ee:transform.doc:name: IDP File Data Staging Request Payload

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/java --- [payload ++ { "Name": if ( upper(vars.doc.documentType) == "DN" ) "DC/DN" else upper(vars.doc.documentType), "Claim__c": vars.claimId, "Checklist_Line__c": vars.document.checklistLineId, "File_Name__c": vars.document.fileName, "Related_Document_Id__c": vars.document.contentDocumentId, "Status__c": p('idp.status.success') }]

logger.doc:name: Payload Debug Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload]

logger.doc:name: Logging File Data Staging Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Document file data staging infromation processing completed", "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "status": vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful }]

logger.doc:name: Payload Debug Logger
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful == true) and (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful == true) ) p('status.pass') else p('status.failed')
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( vars.idpItemDetailResponse.successful != true ) vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.items[0].message default [] else []

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful == true) and (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful == true) ) p('idp.status.success') else p('idp.status.failed')

logger.doc:name: Logging Item Detail Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Document item detail infromation processing completed", "fileName": vars.document.fileName, "status": vars.idpItemDetailResponse.successful }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful != true) ) p('status.failed') else p('status.pass')
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful != true ) vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.items[0].message default [] else []
%dw 2.0 output application/json --- if ( (vars.idpFileDataStagingResponse.successful != true) ) p('idp.status.failed') else p('idp.status.success')

logger.doc:name: Logging Document Status And Item Details
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": if ( !isEmpty(vars.tables) ) "Failed to process the file data staging records; therefore, item details were not processed" else "No item details found for the document", "fileName": vars.document.fileName }]

set-variable.value: #["No fields or data were extracted from the document Using IDP"]
set-variable.doc:name: Content Version Message Variable

logger.doc:name: No Fields Found In Document

raise-error.description: #["IDP extraction completed, confidence score is less than" ++ p('confidenceScoreThreshold')]

logger.doc:name: Logging Validation Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Request matched the JSON Schema and the confidence score is above " ++ p('confidenceScoreThreshold'), "fileName": vars.document.fileName }]

logger.doc:name: Logging Task Information
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "status": "Failed", "claimNumber": vars.claimNumber, "message": vars.task, }]

logger.doc:name: Logging Task Update Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": if ( payload.successful == true ) "Task creation has succeeded in Salesforce." else "Task creation has failed in Salesforce.", "status": payload.successful }]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filter ((item, index) -> item.Status == "Open")

logger.doc:name: Logging Claim Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload]

logger.doc:name: Logging Claim Update Status
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": if ( payload.successful == true ) "Claim status updated successfully in Salesforce." else "Failed to update claim status in Salesforce.", "claimNumber": vars.claimNumber, "status": payload.successful }]
